chapters.title: Welcome to Lanternreach
chapters.sourceObjective: Speak with Rowan, visit the banker, auctioneer and class trainer.
chapters.hook: Rowan: “Before you run into the wilds, learn where you'll return when your bags are full.”

chapters.title: Slime at the Gates
chapters.sourceObjective: Defeat 6 Woodland Slimes outside Lanternreach.
chapters.hook: “They've crept closer every morning. Clear the road before someone gets hurt.”

chapters.title: What the Slime Left Behind
chapters.sourceObjective: Defeat Woodland Slimes and collect 5 Slime Residue.
chapters.hook: “Don't wipe that off your blade. Bring me a sample.”

chapters.title: A Bitter Remedy
chapters.sourceObjective: Gather 6 Wild Herbs.
chapters.hook: “Steel closes wounds poorly. Bring me herbs and I'll show you what keeps adventurers alive.”

chapters.title: Wolves on Pinewake
chapters.sourceObjective: Defeat 8 Bramble Wolves in Pinewake Hills.
chapters.hook: “The Pinewake trail has gone quiet. Too quiet.”

chapters.title: Webbed Supplies
chapters.sourceObjective: Defeat 6 Grove Spiders; recover 4 Supply Bundles.
chapters.hook: “The caravan made it halfway back. The spiders kept the rest.”

chapters.title: The Old Campfire
chapters.sourceObjective: Find The Last Campfire and inspect the abandoned pack.
chapters.hook: “Someone camped beyond the fen and never came home.”

chapters.title: Crystals for the Road
chapters.sourceObjective: Mine 5 Grove Crystals.
chapters.hook: “Bring me clean crystal and I'll make sure your gear survives the road.”

chapters.title: The Fen Garden
chapters.sourceObjective: Travel to Slimefen Herb Garden; gather 4 Wild Herbs.
chapters.hook: “The fen looks foul, but the soil grows medicine better than any tidy garden.”

chapters.title: Briar in the Meadow
chapters.sourceObjective: Defeat 10 Briar Sentinels in Silverreach Meadow.
chapters.hook: “The briars aren't wandering. They're guarding something.”

chapters.title: Roots With Teeth
chapters.sourceObjective: Collect 6 Thorned Root Fragments from Briar Sentinels.
chapters.hook: “These roots are fresh-cut. Whatever controls them is close.”

chapters.title: The Sealed Root
chapters.sourceObjective: Enter the Greenwood Root Chamber; clear 5 rooms and activate 2 root seals.
chapters.hook: “I found a door beneath the roots. It wasn't built by anything living here now.”

chapters.title: Boars of Bracken Crown
chapters.sourceObjective: Defeat 10 Briar Boars.
chapters.hook: “They've torn up every trail marker from here to the Crown.”

chapters.title: A Better Bowstring
chapters.sourceObjective: Collect 5 Tough Sinew from wolves/boars.
chapters.hook: “A weapon is only as reliable as the piece everyone ignores.”

chapters.title: Whispers from the Isles
chapters.sourceObjective: Reach Whispering Isles and inspect 3 marked stones.
chapters.hook: “Three stones started glowing the same night. I don't believe in coincidence.”

chapters.title: The Rootvault Calls
chapters.sourceObjective: Enter The Rootvault and complete the final encounter.
chapters.hook: “The roots beneath Greenwood all lead to one place. End this at the source.”

chapters.title: A Message for Sable
chapters.sourceObjective: Travel to Amberwild and deliver Rowan's sealed note.
chapters.hook: Sable: “Rowan only seals a letter when the problem is worse than the words.”

chapters.title: Redleaf Patrol
chapters.sourceObjective: Defeat 10 enemies in Redleaf Highlands.
chapters.hook: “Walk the ridge. If something moves against the wind, kill it.”

chapters.title: Ash in the Bark
chapters.sourceObjective: Collect 6 scorched bark/ember samples from Cindergrove enemies.
chapters.hook: “This burn didn't come from a campfire.”

chapters.title: Copperstep Tools
chapters.sourceObjective: Mine 6 crystals at Copperstep Quarry.
chapters.hook: “You want better steel? First learn where its bones come from.”

chapters.title: The Missing Surveyor
chapters.sourceObjective: Find 3 survey markers, then locate the missing surveyor's camp.
chapters.hook: “He was mapping a safe road. Now even his markers are disappearing.”

chapters.title: Beetles in the Cinders
chapters.sourceObjective: Defeat 12 Ember Beetles.
chapters.hook: “Small things become disasters when everyone decides they're someone else's problem.”

chapters.title: Heatproofing
chapters.sourceObjective: Collect 8 Ember Shell Fragments.
chapters.hook: “Bring me their shells. If they can survive that heat, your armor can learn from them.”

chapters.title: The Broken Watch
chapters.sourceObjective: Clear 6 rooms; repair 3 watch mechanisms; defeat chamber guardian.
chapters.hook: “The old watchtower still has power. Something below it is using it.”

chapters.title: Sunscar Wreckage
chapters.sourceObjective: Search Sunscar Coast; recover 5 cargo crates.
chapters.hook: “The sea returned the ship. It didn't return the crew.”

chapters.title: Salt and Scales
chapters.sourceObjective: Collect 6 monster meat/scales from Sunscar creatures.
chapters.hook: “Adventurers complain about rations until they've tried going without them.”

chapters.title: Emberfall Trail
chapters.sourceObjective: Reach Emberfall Ridge; defeat 8 local enemies.
chapters.hook: “Follow the heat. Whatever is waking up is leaving a trail.”

chapters.title: Runes in the Ash
chapters.sourceObjective: Collect 5 Burnt Rune Fragments from enemies around Emberfall.
chapters.hook: “They're pieces of a lock. Let's find the door.”

chapters.title: Ashbound Hall
chapters.sourceObjective: 7-room chamber: clear → key → ambush → lever → defense → treasure → boss.
chapters.hook: “Once you're inside, don't trust the first open door.”

chapters.title: Cindercrypt
chapters.sourceObjective: Complete Cindercrypt.
chapters.hook: “The crypt is open. Whatever is below has stopped pretending to sleep.”

chapters.title: Cold Welcome
chapters.sourceObjective: Speak to Iona; visit Frostmarch town services.
chapters.hook: “Out here, preparation kills more monsters than bravery.”

chapters.title: Wisps in the Snow
chapters.sourceObjective: Defeat 10 Ice Wisps.
chapters.hook: “The wisps are clustering around the old paths. Find out why.”

chapters.title: Frozen Cores
chapters.sourceObjective: Collect 6 Wisp Cores.
chapters.hook: “Don't crack them. I need to know what's trapped inside.”

chapters.title: Northglass Hunt
chapters.sourceObjective: Defeat 8 Frost Yetis in/near Northglass routes.
chapters.hook: “One yeti is wildlife. Eight near the road is a warning.”

chapters.title: Glacial Supper
chapters.sourceObjective: Catch 4 fish appropriate to the region/profession level.
chapters.hook: “The ice gives food to people patient enough to listen.”

chapters.title: Blueglass Samples
chapters.sourceObjective: Collect Star Fragments / appropriate crystal nodes at Blueglass Cave.
chapters.hook: “The cave is singing again. Bring me a piece before the sound changes.”

chapters.title: Tracks Across Stormcrag
chapters.sourceObjective: Follow 5 track markers through Stormcrag Tundra.
chapters.hook: “Something large crossed the tundra. It knew exactly where it was going.”

chapters.title: The Lost Scout
chapters.sourceObjective: Find the scout; defend them against 3 waves.
chapters.hook: “Bring them home alive. I don't need another heroic corpse.”

chapters.title: Three Frozen Seals
chapters.sourceObjective: Locate and activate 3 ancient seals.
chapters.hook: “The seals aren't keeping us out. They're keeping something in.”

chapters.title: Memory Beneath Ice
chapters.sourceObjective: 8 rooms: runes, survival, frozen keys, mini-boss, final guardian.
chapters.hook: “Whatever you see in there, remember: memories can lie.”

chapters.title: Rimefang's Shadow
chapters.sourceObjective: Participate in Rimefang Matriarch encounter or investigate her territory.
chapters.hook: “Don't go there to prove you're strong. Go because the road won't be safe until you do.”

chapters.title: Frosthollow
chapters.sourceObjective: Complete Frosthollow.
chapters.hook: “The Hollow under the ice is awake. We finish this below.”

chapters.title: Lanterns in the Marsh
chapters.sourceObjective: Light 4 ward lanterns through Moonfen Marsh.
chapters.hook: “If the lantern goes dark, don't stop to ask why.”

chapters.title: Leeches in the Moonfen
chapters.sourceObjective: Defeat 12 Mire Leeches.
chapters.hook: “The marsh is hungry. Today it can eat something else.”

chapters.title: Blackwater Samples
chapters.sourceObjective: Collect 6 Tainted Water Samples / leech residue.
chapters.hook: “The water changed before the creatures did.”

chapters.title: Bones That Move
chapters.sourceObjective: Defeat 10 Bone Rats / Crypt Bats in Hollow routes.
chapters.hook: “The dead aren't the problem. It's what keeps waking them.”

chapters.title: Scarabs Below
chapters.sourceObjective: Defeat 10 Corpse Scarabs; collect 5 Carapaces.
chapters.hook: “Their shells carry the same mark as the crypt door.”

chapters.title: Moonpetal Remedy
chapters.sourceObjective: Gather 6 Moonpetal / appropriate herbs.
chapters.hook: “If you're going deeper, take something that can pull you back.”

chapters.title: The Wounded Caravan
chapters.sourceObjective: Escort caravan survivors through a hostile stretch.
chapters.hook: “They won't make the road alone. Neither will the supplies.”

chapters.title: Shadewood Voices
chapters.sourceObjective: Inspect 4 whispering trees in Shadewood Wilds.
chapters.hook: “If a tree says your name, do not answer it.”

chapters.title: The Hollow Door
chapters.sourceObjective: Clear 8 rooms with darkness, ambushes, keys and a protection objective.
chapters.hook: “This door opens inward. That's what worries me.”

chapters.title: Nightroot Citadel
chapters.sourceObjective: Complete Nightroot Citadel.
chapters.hook: “The Citadel isn't abandoned. It has simply stopped inviting guests.”

chapters.title: Copper for the Cure
chapters.sourceObjective: Mine Copper/Cobalt-tier resources needed for a ward device.
chapters.hook: “Magic fails. Metal usually fails later.”

chapters.title: Carrion Trail
chapters.sourceObjective: Defeat 12 Carrion Hounds.
chapters.hook: “Follow the hounds and you'll find what they're feeding on.”

chapters.title: Void at the Shore
chapters.sourceObjective: Defeat 10 Void Stalkers in Umbral Shores.
chapters.hook: “They don't leave tracks. They leave absences.”

chapters.title: Plague Signs
chapters.sourceObjective: Collect 6 plague samples; inspect 3 broken mechanisms.
chapters.hook: “Someone built this disease. That means someone built a way to stop it.”

chapters.title: The Plagueworks
chapters.sourceObjective: Complete The Plagueworks.
chapters.hook: “Don't destroy everything. First learn what the machine was meant to do.”

chapters.title: Water Before Glory
chapters.sourceObjective: Carry supplies from Sunveil Bazaar to Dunewell Oasis.
chapters.hook: “Heroes die of thirst too. Take the water.”

chapters.title: Scorpions at Dunewell
chapters.sourceObjective: Defeat 12 Dune Scorpions.
chapters.hook: “The oasis belongs to whoever can reach the water. Make sure that's us.”

chapters.title: Venom for Medicine
chapters.sourceObjective: Collect 6 Scorpion Venom Sacs.
chapters.hook: “Poison and medicine are often the same thing with better measurements.”

chapters.title: Stone in the Sand
chapters.sourceObjective: Defeat 8 Stone Golems.
chapters.hook: “Those statues moved last night. I would prefer they stop.”

chapters.title: The Buried Markers
chapters.sourceObjective: Find 5 half-buried expedition markers.
chapters.hook: “Sand doesn't erase history. It only makes you work for it.”

chapters.title: Oasis Contract
chapters.sourceObjective: Defeat regional enemies; recover 8 stolen supply pieces.
chapters.hook: “Someone is feeding on the roads. Cut off their appetite.”

chapters.title: Saffron Bloom
chapters.sourceObjective: Gather region-appropriate herbs / Sunblossom if profession permits.
chapters.hook: “The desert flowers once. Miss it and you wait another season.”

chapters.title: Glass Underfoot
chapters.sourceObjective: Collect 6 Glass Shards from Glass Dunes enemies/objects.
chapters.hook: “These pieces were shaped before the dunes existed.”

chapters.title: Badlands Signal
chapters.sourceObjective: Activate 3 signal pylons across Sunveil Badlands.
chapters.hook: “Light all three. If something answers, we'll know where to look.”

chapters.title: The Ashen Crown
chapters.sourceObjective: Participate in Ashen Crown Titan encounter.
chapters.hook: “You wanted to know what answered the signal. There it is.”

chapters.title: Emberfall Foundry
chapters.sourceObjective: Complete Emberfall Foundry; activate required rune seals.
chapters.hook: “The Foundry doesn't make weapons anymore. It makes problems.”

chapters.title: The Paymaster's Ledger
chapters.sourceObjective: Reach optional strongroom/cache and recover a ledger.
chapters.hook: “Someone was paying the workers after the Foundry should have been empty.”

chapters.title: Cooling the Crown
chapters.sourceObjective: Collect 8 foundry components / slag samples.
chapters.hook: “Bring me pieces that survived the furnace.”

chapters.title: Temple Keys
chapters.sourceObjective: Collect 3 temple keys from elite enemies in Glass Dunes.
chapters.hook: “Three locks. Three keepers. None willing to hand over a key.”

chapters.title: Temple of the Veiled Sun
chapters.sourceObjective: 10-room temple with traps, key doors, optional treasure and guardian.
chapters.sourceReward: Large XP + Epic material + title progress
chapters.hook: “The temple rewards patience. The traps reward impatience.”

chapters.title: The Road Into Mist
chapters.sourceObjective: Carry recovered temple record to Mistwood Haven.
chapters.hook: “Take this to Talan. If he recognizes the symbol, our problem is older than the desert.”

chapters.title: Under the Canopy
chapters.sourceObjective: Reach 3 landmarks in Canopy Reach.
chapters.hook: “The jungle has roads. They simply move more often than ours.”

chapters.title: Jade Sentinels
chapters.sourceObjective: Defeat 10 Jade Sentinels.
chapters.hook: “They were built to guard something. Find out what.”

chapters.title: Broken Jade
chapters.sourceObjective: Collect 6 Sentinel Fragments.
chapters.hook: “Every fragment has the same inscription on the inside.”

chapters.title: Rainforest Remedies
chapters.sourceObjective: Gather 6 high-tier herbs / appropriate resources.
chapters.hook: “Mistwood grows cures beside poisons. Learn the difference.”

chapters.title: The Bell That Rings Alone
chapters.sourceObjective: Locate 3 jungle bells/shrines and ring them in order.
chapters.hook: “No one has touched those bells in years. They still ring at dusk.”

chapters.title: Veilhaven Monastery
chapters.sourceObjective: Complete Veilhaven Monastery.
chapters.hook: “If the Abbess still guards the answer, ask politely once.”

chapters.title: The Abbess's Fragment
chapters.sourceObjective: Recover a specific relic from monastery content.
chapters.hook: “This is not treasure. It's a piece of an instruction.”

chapters.title: Mistwood Basin Hunt
chapters.sourceObjective: Defeat 12 high-level jungle enemies.
chapters.hook: “The Basin has stopped making noise. Restore the natural kind.”

chapters.title: Ancient Timber
chapters.sourceObjective: Gather Elderwood / appropriate high-tier wood.
chapters.hook: “One branch can outlive a house. Don't waste it.”

chapters.title: Orchid Isles
chapters.sourceObjective: Search 4 island ruins; collect 4 inscription rubbings.
chapters.hook: “The same symbol appears on islands that never shared a bridge.”

chapters.title: A Path Within
chapters.sourceObjective: Speak to class trainer; demonstrate class mastery in combat.
chapters.sourceReward: Job XP + SP quest unlock flag
chapters.hook: “You've learned how to fight as you are. Now decide what you want to become.”

chapters.title: Fragments of the First Path
chapters.sourceObjective: Collect rare class fragments from level-appropriate monsters.
chapters.hook: “The fragments won't answer to someone who lets others do the work.”

chapters.title: Trial of Instinct
chapters.sourceObjective: Class-specific 7-room trial emphasizing role mechanics.
chapters.hook: “Your weapon is not being tested. Your decisions are.”

chapters.title: Proof From the Depths
chapters.sourceObjective: Acquire a class relic from a designated high-level dungeon boss.
chapters.hook: “Bring me proof that your strength survives outside a training yard.”

chapters.title: Trial of Resolve
chapters.sourceObjective: 9-room trial with survival, puzzle and mini-boss.
chapters.hook: “Power is easy when everything goes according to plan.”

chapters.title: The Final Calling
chapters.sourceObjective: Combine class fragments, dungeon relic and ancient material at a shrine.
chapters.hook: “Everything you've carried here becomes one choice.”

chapters.title: Trial of the First Path
chapters.sourceObjective: 12–15 rooms; class mechanics, elite waves, final class-specific boss.
chapters.sourceReward: Unlock SP1 at SP Job Lv.1
chapters.hook: “Enter as you are. If you return, you won't fight the same way again.”

sideQuestTemplates.Objective: Kill 10–20 enemies in an on-level area.
Collect monster materials or gathered resources.
Search a marked wilderness area; escort survivor back.
Defeat a named elite spawned after tracking clues.
Gather on-level herbs and deliver them.
Recover crates from enemies or wilderness objects.
Interact with 3–5 shrines and provide materials.
Kill a specific dungeon enemy / inspect a room object.

chamberRoomTypes.Interaction: Door unlocks when enemies are cleared.

Interact with levers, bells, runes or seals in an order.

Move an NPC through several rooms.
Choose safe route or harder optional treasure room.

Iona: “There is a chamber beneath the ice. The scouts heard voices from inside—voices belonging to people who died years ago.”
Iona: “Open the three seals. If the chamber shows you someone you know, remember why you came.”
Activate 3 Frozen Seals → Enter Frozen Memory → Reach the central archive → Defeat the Memory Warden.
Iona (message): “The second door reacts to the runes. Look at the walls before touching anything.”
Iona: “You're back. Good. Don't tell me what it showed you yet.”
Iona: “First, tell me what was guarding the archive.”
Quest Complete → XP + Rare Accessory + next story quest.

rewardGuidance.Typical reward: SP materials throughout; SP unlock only at the end
